contract.name: Escrow
contract.description: Hackathon escrow contract that holds prize funds (ERC20 or native ETH), enforces dual-approval from organizer and sponsor, and allows winners to self-claim payouts.

functions.name: setIntentSpecURI
functions.intent: Sets the machine-readable semantic metadata URI for this contract.
preconditions: Caller must be the organizer.
risks: URI should reference immutable content; a mutable URI may mislead agents.

functions.name: whitelistSponsor
functions.intent: Grants a sponsor address permission to create and fund challenges in this escrow.
preconditions: Caller must be the organizer.
Sponsor must not already be whitelisted.
effects: Sponsor address is added to the whitelist; emits SponsorWhitelisted.
risks: No on-chain identity verification of the sponsor address.

functions.name: revokeSponsor
functions.intent: Removes a sponsor from the whitelist, preventing them from creating new challenges.
preconditions: Caller must be the organizer.
Contract must not be locked.
Sponsor must currently be whitelisted.
effects: Sponsor is removed from the whitelist; emits SponsorRevoked.
functions.agentGuidance: Existing challenges by this sponsor remain valid; only new challenge creation is blocked.

functions.name: getWhitelistedSponsors
functions.intent: Retrieves all currently whitelisted sponsor addresses.

functions.name: addChallenge
functions.intent: Creates a new prize challenge with the specified prize pool, token, and metadata.
preconditions: Caller must be a whitelisted sponsor.
Contract must not be locked.
Total prize must be greater than zero.
effects: A new challenge is stored; challengeCount is incremented; emits ChallengeAdded.
risks: The challenge is created unfunded; sponsor must call fundChallenge separately.
functions.agentGuidance: Verify the token address is a legitimate ERC20 contract when isERC20 is true.

functions.name: getChallengeIds
functions.intent: Returns the full array of challenge IDs for enumeration.
risks: May be gas-heavy for very large challenge counts; prefer getChallengesPage.

functions.name: getChallengesPage
functions.intent: Returns a paginated slice of challenges for efficient enumeration.

functions.name: fundChallenge
functions.intent: Transfers the full prize amount (ERC20 or native ETH) from the sponsor into escrow.
preconditions: Caller must be the challenge sponsor.
Contract must not be locked.
Challenge must exist and not already be funded.
For ERC20: sponsor must have approved the escrow for at least totalPrize tokens.
For native ETH: msg.value must exactly equal totalPrize.
effects: Tokens/ETH are transferred to the escrow; challenge.isFunded is set to true; emits ChallengeFunded.
risks: Irreversible deposit unless refundChallenge is used before dual approval completes.
functions.agentGuidance: For ERC20, call approve on the token contract before calling fundChallenge.

functions.name: getChallenge
functions.intent: Retrieves all stored data for a specific challenge.

functions.name: challengeTokenDecimals
functions.intent: Returns the decimal precision of the prize token for display purposes.

functions.name: lockContract
functions.intent: Locks the escrow to prevent further configuration changes (challenges, winners, funding).
preconditions: Caller must be the organizer.
Contract must not already be locked.
effects: isLocked is set to true; emits ConfigurationLocked.
risks: Approvals and claims remain available after lock; only configuration is frozen.

functions.name: addWinners
functions.intent: Assigns prize allocations to winner addresses for a funded challenge. Resets prior approvals.
preconditions: Caller must be the organizer.
Contract must not be locked.
Challenge must exist and be funded.
Winners and allocations arrays must be non-empty, equal length, no zero addresses or amounts, no duplicates.
Sum of allocations must exactly equal totalPrize.
effects: Allocations are written; approvals are reset to false; winnerCount is set; emits WinnersAdded.
risks: Calling addWinners again overwrites previous allocations and resets approvals. Sponsor must re-approve.
functions.agentGuidance: Verify allocations sum to totalPrize off-chain before submitting.

functions.name: approveDistribution
functions.intent: Records an approval from either the sponsor or the organizer for prize distribution.
preconditions: Caller must be the challenge sponsor or the organizer.
Caller must not have already approved.
effects: Sets sponsorApproved or organiserApproved to true; emits DistributionApproved.
functions.agentGuidance: Both approvals are required before any winner can claimPayout.

functions.name: claimPayout
functions.intent: Transfers the caller's allocated prize (ERC20 or ETH) after both approvals are confirmed.
preconditions: Caller must be an assigned winner for this challenge.
Caller must not have already claimed.
Both sponsor and organizer must have approved distribution.
effects: Allocation is marked claimed; funds are transferred; claimedCount incremented; isPaidOut set if all claimed; emits PrizeClaimed.
risks: Irreversible transfer of funds to the caller.
functions.agentGuidance: Check approvals(challengeId) before calling to avoid a revert.

functions.name: refundChallenge
functions.intent: Returns deposited funds to the sponsor when dual approval is not yet complete.
preconditions: Caller must be the challenge sponsor.
Challenge must be funded and not fully paid out.
Dual approval must NOT be complete (at least one party has not approved).
effects: Challenge is marked unfunded; approvals are reset; funds returned to sponsor; emits ChallengeRefunded.
risks: Irreversible; challenge must be re-funded to proceed with payouts.

functions.name: unLockContract
functions.intent: Unlocks the escrow to allow configuration changes again.
preconditions: Caller must be the organizer.
effects: isLocked is set to false; emits ConfigurationUnLocked.

events.name: SponsorWhitelisted
events.description: Organizer added a sponsor to the whitelist.

events.name: SponsorRevoked
events.description: Organizer removed a sponsor from the whitelist.

events.name: ChallengeAdded
events.description: A new prize challenge was created by a whitelisted sponsor.

events.name: ChallengeFunded
events.description: Sponsor deposited ERC20 tokens or native ETH to fund a challenge.

events.name: WinnersAdded
events.description: Organizer assigned winner addresses and prize allocations to a challenge.

events.name: DistributionApproved
events.description: Sponsor or organizer approved the distribution for a challenge.

events.name: PrizeClaimed
events.description: A winner withdrew their allocated prize.

events.name: ChallengeRefunded
events.description: Sponsor reclaimed funds from an unapproved challenge.

events.name: ConfigurationLocked
events.description: Organizer locked the escrow preventing further configuration changes.

events.name: ConfigurationUnLocked
events.description: Organizer unlocked the escrow allowing configuration changes.

invariants: Total claimable allocations for a challenge always equal the challenge totalPrize.
Funds can only leave the contract through claimPayout (to winners) or refundChallenge (to sponsor).
A payout requires both sponsor and organizer approval.
